up: Retrieve canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4725214. Filter activities to exact values only by requiring standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL. Join assays (where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725214'), activities, compound_structures (on molregno), and molecule_dictionary (on molregno to retrieve the molecule ChEMBL ID). Return canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id, and exact activity values.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_value AS exact_activity_value FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725214' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
